cover_sensitivity.method: Directly counted accepted article-only strings, not subtraction of token totals.

boundary.program_representations: Whole printed appendix or thirteen full raw files, alternatives never both.
boundary.conditional: After acquisition of whole U_G and all thirteen complete programs, including validation; roles remain distinct.
boundary.source_qualifications: The accepted corrected principal contracts and all recorded exclusions apply. Full source length does not claim recovery of every printed auxiliary assertion.
boundary.interpretation: Available complete text lengths in the fixed representation, not total research effort or minimum proof length.
